title: Hypatia of Alexandria — a declared absence: the lost works named, and the witnesses in which her work and her life survive
edition: No edition held. The seat holds the declaration of what it would hold: declared/absence.json and declared/absence.md.

license.payload: The declaration is the archive's own, CC-BY-4.0. The works it names are not held.

normalization: None: the declaration is held as written.
scope: Declared, not seated: Hypatia, Commentary on Diophantus, Arithmetica, opens: lost or embedded; Hypatia, Commentary on Apollonius of Perga, Conics, opens: lost; Hypatia, Astronomical Canon, opens: lost; Hypatia, Ptolemy, Almagest III, the revised text, opens: embedded in the Almagest as transmitted. Wanted, and open: Synesius of Cyrene's letters to and about her, in Greek (seven to her survive, none of hers to him); Socrates Scholasticus, Historia ecclesiastica VII.15; the Suda (Υ 166), with Damascius' Life of Isidore as it carries; Philostorgius and Hesychius as quoted; John of Nikiu's chronicle, in Ge'ez; the heading of Theon's commentary on Almagest III; Diophantus' Arithmetica in Tannery's edition (1893–1895). QUEUED.

why_seated: MANUS, 27 October 2026, after the twenty-seventh seating entered Deleuze and Guattari as a declared absence: "and a declared absence/ wanted seating: hypatia, d & g, pkd, allen ginsberg, anne carson, and tao lin - including the mandalas. and paul klee. too many files and too many image copyright landmines." Hypatia is entered as an absence of a different kind from the others of this seating. Her works are not held back by copyright; they are lost, or they survive inside other texts under other names. The Suda names a commentary on Diophantus, a commentary on Apollonius' Conics and an Astronomical Canon, and the heading of Theon's commentary on the third book of Ptolemy's Almagest credits the text to an edition "revised by my daughter Hypatia, the philosopher". What can be seated are the witnesses: Synesius' letters to her, the historians who record her life and death, and the texts in which her editing is believed to stand.
ruling: A declared absence, the wanted seating: the works named, with their rights and opening dates, and no text (MANUS, 2026-10-27).
